annotations.title: Inventory EOQ, safety stock and reorder point

description: Inventory EOQ, safety stock and reorder point — Economic order quantity with total annual ordering + holding cost, orders per year, days between orders, safety stock for a target service level (demand and lead-time variability), reorder point, average inventory, turns and a cost sensitivity table. Params: demand (annual units), order_cost, holding ($/unit/year) or holding_pct + unit_cost; optional lead_days (7), daily_sd or demand_cv (%), lead_sd, service (% default 95), moq, days_per_year (365). Offline. Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: business_eoq
